description:
Phase 2 of deliberation. New mode "deliberate-deep": after both providers draft (v1 deliberate), each provider adjudicates the OTHER's divergent (one-sided) findings — confirmed | disputed | unsure + reason — so agreement becomes semantic, not positional, and false positives are caught. Motivated by dogfooding v1 (two same-meaning findings stayed divergent under exact-key matching; a shared false positive slipped through).

Design: add an optional crossReview capability to ReviewBackend (leaves implement via the orchestrator's structured-output turn; composites don't expose it). New CrossReviewResult schema ({adjudications: {index, verdict, reason}[]}) + buildCrossReviewPrompt + runCrossReview in the orchestrator, wired in codex.ts + gemini.ts. The deliberation composite, when built for deliberate-deep, runs 2 cross-review calls (each provider judges the other's divergent findings) and attaches an optional `adjudication` to each divergent item in the deliberation block. Best-effort: cross-review failure degrades to the v1 computed map. Findings presented neutrally ("another reviewer flagged"); heavy anonymization deferred (only matters at 3+ providers). Config: mode enum gains 'deliberate-deep'. Scope: plan + code. TDD; live-verify.
title: Cross-review round (deliberate-deep): providers adjudicate each other's divergent findings
